question: On November 19, 2025, which country was formally designated by the United States as a Major Non-NATO Ally?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saudi Arabia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The United States formally designated Saudi Arabia as a Major Non-NATO Ally on November 19, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The MNNA status grants Saudi Arabia access to advanced US defense technologies and military privileges without a mutual defense commitment.**
 
• **The US approved the sale of F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia, making it the first Arab nation to receive the fifth-generation aircraft.**
 
• **Both nations signed major cooperation deals in civil nuclear energy, artificial intelligence, and critical minerals.**
 
• **The agreement enhances US-Saudi strategic, defense, and technological partnership under Saudi Vision 2030.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **MNNA status allows joint R&D programmes, priority access to US weapons, and stockpiling of US equipment.**
 
• **Around 20 countries hold MNNA status globally.**
 
• **The deal also includes nearly 300 advanced US tanks and expanded Gulf-region logistics cooperation.**
 
• **Strategic implications include regional military balance and enhanced US presence in West Asia.**
